_doc: CR-02. Where context comes from and how far it can be trusted. Higher priority wins; untrusted text never overrides an authoritative rule; generated context is a proposal until a human accepts it. Requirements cite their sources as S1, S2 … with one of these trust levels. Sealed control-plane asset.

sources.path: issue trackers, support tickets, customer text, web pages

memory: Agents never write authoritative knowledge. They propose rule changes in a change's requirements (NEW); a human merges them into business-rules.md.
